# Litehaus

> A modular construction marketplace connecting clients with builders across Portugal and Spain, specializing in LSF, CLT, and wood-frame prefab homes with 3D construction technology.

Litehaus operates a platform for modular and prefab housing solutions in Southern Europe, offering a catalog of designer homes, financing options, and construction guides. The site serves as both a marketplace for builders and an educational resource for prospective homeowners exploring sustainable, efficient building methods.

## Key Topics

- LSF (Light Steel Frame)
- CLT (Cross-Laminated Timber)
- Modular Construction
- Prefab Homes
- Wood-Frame Housing
- 3D Construction
- Sustainable Building
- Construction Financing
- Builder Matching
- Portugal
- Spain
- Loan Calculator
- Property Listing
- Construction Methods
- Timber Construction

## Home Catalog

- [Modular Construction Catalog](https://litehaus.co/catalogo): Complete catalog of LSF, CLT, and wood-frame prefab home models
- [Villa T3 Toronto](https://litehaus.co/catalogo/villa-t3-toronto): LSF 3-bedroom prefab home with thermal insulation and loan calculator
- [Villa T3 San Diego](https://litehaus.co/catalogo/villa-t3-san-diego): Modular LSF prefab home with 3D construction technology
- [Villa T2 Matera](https://litehaus.co/catalogo/villa-t2---matera): Wood-frame modular housing with LSF/CLT construction and financing
- [Villa T3 Hamburg](https://litehaus.co/catalogo/villa-t3---hamburg): Wood-frame modular prefab home with residential design features
- [Villa T3 Chamine](https://litehaus.co/catalogo/villa-t3---chamine): LSF/CLT modular home in Portugal/Spain with 3D construction
